'''Ta'a Chume's estate''' was an area of the [[Fountain Palace]] on [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]] where former [[Queen Mother]] [[Ta'a Chume]] resided and was held under house arrest after attempting to poison [[Teneniel Djo]]. It was here in [[36 ABY]], after the attempt on [[Allana Djo Solo|his daughter's]] life, that [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Torture/Legends|torture]] information out of Ta'a Chume and eventually gave her a brain hemorrhage, rendering her comatose.
